name: Chessboard
description: Chessboard is a board of n × n squares arranged in two alternating colors (black and white). Top left square is white. You are given board size n . Output an image of a chessboard, with black and white squares marked with '#' and '.' characters, respectively.
input_specification: The only line of input contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 9 ).
output_specification: Output an image of n × n chessboard.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
